opportunities.description: RfP26/03357: Company to Conduct Integrated Assessment of Information Systems of the National Agency for Auto Transport United Nations Development Programme, through its “ Greening the Future, Advancing Rights and Stability: Spurring an Inclusive and Green Transition with Responsive Governance in the Eastern Neighbourhood Region ” Project hereby invites prospective proposers to submit a proposal in accordance with the General Conditions of Contract and the Terms of Reference as set out in this Request for Proposal (RFP). To enable you to submit a proposal, please read the following attached documents carefully. Section 1: This Letter of Invitation Section 2: Instruction to Proposers Section 3: Data Sheet Section 4: Evaluation Criteria Section 5: Terms of Reference Section 6: Conditions of Contract and Contract Forms Section 7: Proposal Forms · Form A: Proposal Confirmation · Form B: Checklist · Form C: Technical Proposal Submission · Form D: Proposer Information · Form E: Joint Venture/Consortium/Association Information · Form F: Eligibility and Qualification · Form G: Format for Technical Proposal · Form H: Format for CV of proposed key personnel · Form I: Statement of Exclusivity and Availability · Form J: Financial Proposal Submission · Form K: Format for Financial Proposal If you are interested in submitting a proposal in response to this RFP, please prepare your proposal in accordance with the requirements and procedure as set out in this RFP and submit it by the deadline for submission of proposals set out in Section 3: Data Sheet. Should you be interested to submit a proposal, please log in to the Quantum NextGenERP supplier portal and subscribe to this tender following the instructions in the system user guide. Please search for the tender using search filters, namely Negotiation ID: UNDP-MDA- 01088 . Once subscribed to the tender, you will be able to receive notifications in case of amendments of the tender document and requirements. Please indicate whether you intend to submit a bid by creating a draft response without submitting directly in the Quantum NextGenERP supplier portal. Offers must be submitted directly in the Quantum NextGenERP supplier portal following this link: http://supplier.quantum.partneragencies.org/ using the profile you may have in the portal (please log in using your username and password). In case you have never registered before, follow the Supplier Portal Registration Link . Should you require further clarifications on the application through the Quantum online portal, kindly contact the Procurement Unit at sc.md@undp.org . Please pay attention that the proposal shall be submitted online through the Quantum system and any proposal sent to the above email shall be disqualified. Should you require further clarifications on the Request for Proposal, Terms of Reference or other requirements, kindly communicate using the messaging functionality in the portal. Deadline for Submission of Offers (Date and Time), which is visible in the online procurement system will be final. System will not accept submission of any proposal after that date and time. It is the responsibility of the bidder to make sure that the proposal is submitted prior to this deadline for submission. Bidders are advised to upload proposal documents and to submit their offer a day prior or well before the date and time indicated under the deadline for submission of Offers. Do not wait until last minute. If Bidder faces any issue during submitting offers at the last minutes prior to the deadline for submission, UNDP may not be able to assist on such a short notice and will not be held liable in such instance. UNDP will not accept any offer that is not submitted directly through the System. We look forward to receiving your proposal. opportunities.title: SDP-011-2026 Chatbot de salud financiera
opportunities.description: Descripción de la Consultoría: Desarrollo de una herramienta virtual de consulta chatbot (asistente híbrido) sobre temas de salud financiera Duración estimada: 6 meses Fecha de inicio : septiembre 2026 Fecha de término: marzo 2027 Número y Título del Proyecto: 01004494 IRCC Durable and safe socioeconomic integration of people on the move in Mexico Objetivo: Diseñar, estructurar, implementar y poner en funcionamiento un asistente virtual automatizado (chatbot) de salud financiera, con el fin de optimizar, agilizar y fortalecer la atención de consultas realizadas por personas en situación de movilidad humana en México. Nombre del Supervisor: Coordinador de Proyecto y Especialista en Inclusión Financiera y Economía Social Descripción de Viajes: No Aplica Lugar de trabajo: A distancia Forma de Pago: Contra entrega de productos a entera satisfacción del PNUD Dedicación: Parcial Al preparar su cotización, guíese por las instrucciones y datos de la SDP. Tenga en cuenta que las ofertas deben enviarse utilizando el Anexo 2: Formulario de presentación de oferta y el Anexo 3 Oferta Técnica y Financiera, directamente en la plataforma Quantum, en la fecha y hora indicadas en la plataforma Quantum. En caso de discrepancia entre el plazo del sistema y el indicado en otro lugar, prevalecerá el plazo del sistema. Es su responsabilidad asegurarse de que su oferta se envíe antes de la fecha límite. Las ofertas recibidas después de la fecha límite de presentación o por fuera de la plataforma Quantum, por cualquier motivo, no serán consideradas para evaluación. Si ya tiene una cuenta, inicie sesión en este enlace: http://supplier.quantum.partneragencies.org/ usando su nombre de usuario (correo) y contraseña. Utilice la función de contraseña/nombre de usuario olvidados si no los recuerda. En caso de que nunca se haya registrado antes, puede registrar un perfil utilizando el enlace de registro dentro de la guía "Registro de proveedores en QUANTUM Prospective". No cree un nuevo perfil si ya tiene uno. Se adjunta guía de cómo presentar ofertas en Quantum. Gracias y quedamos a la espera de su cotización. UNIDAD DE ADQUISICIONES PNUD MÉXICO **Para dudas o aclaraciones de este proceso, puede contactarnos mediante el sistema de mensajes de la plataforma Quantum, o a través del correo electrónico: licitaciones@undp.org en donde con gusto le atenderemos de lunes a jueves de 8:30 a 17:00 horas, y viernes de 8:30 a 12:00 horas Centro de México.

opportunities.description: The United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (UNOCHA) at Geneva is looking for a competent and experienced vendor to establish a contract for the provision of technical support, maintenance and enhancement of Salesforce Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Solution. The duration of the contract is expected to be for a period of 1 year with possibility of extension for four (4) additional periods of one year each (1+1+1+1+1). The service shall commence in November 2026. ‎ Vendors are requested to express their interest by sending their Expression of Interest (EOI) ‎response form by the closing date set forth in this REOI.‎ Specific Requirements/Information The potential vendor should have recognized expertise in Salesforce, including certification as a Salesforce Non-profit cloud consultant certification. ===========================INFORMATION=========================== UN OCHA is committed to achieving diversity and inclusion in terms of gender, nationality, disability and culture amongst our prospective suppliers. Disability-inclusive and women-owned/controlled businesses may use the UNGM functionality to indicate their status in UN vendor database and are equally encouraged to express their interest. All responses will be treated with the strictest confidence. ================================================================== Contacts Links UNSPSC codes Email address: ochabuyer@un.org
